Head of AI Enablement & Digital Workplace

Stockholm, Stockholm, Sweden

EQT is looking for a Head of AI Enablement & Digital Workplace to lead firm-wide adoption of AI tooling and own the day-to-day digital workplace experience.

About the Role

Set the strategic direction for AI enablement and the digital workplace, lead a team of six, and serve as a credible voice to executive stakeholders.

  • Lead AI adoption strategy end to end.
  • Build and sustain a network of AI champions across the firm.
